title: The dream of 18,980! Lilies launch membership offensive –  SV Darmstadt 1898 e.V.
content: SV Darmstadt 98 is entering the new second division season with an ambitious vision: The club's membership is set to increase to 18,980, reflecting the year of its founding. Therefore, SV 98 is calling on all fans and supporters to become part of the Lilien family. To break this milestone, SV 98 has planned many exclusive promotions and experiences for its members for the upcoming season. At the start of the season, randomly selected members were treated to a very special highlight: a members‘ match was played on the Bölle pitch as part of the season opening celebration. Another highlight is also planned after the end of the transfer window: As a symbol of the connection between team and fans, a team photo will be taken together with club members in the stadium. The summer break is drawing to a close, and this coming Sunday (June 28th), the Darmstadt professionals will be back on the training pitch for the first time, officially starting their preparations for the 2026/27 second division season.
